mira: Noticed a post-maintenance spike in Vault leases for staging. ~600 leases showing renews but no active attachments. Started at ~01:50 UTC.
ben: where are the leases scoped? mount paths?
mira: looks like secret/data/services/* and secret/data/partners/* primarily. sample lease: lease-9f4b2c, created_by=svc-infer-worker@redwood, ttl=86400, last_renew=1778881800.
dalia: were any KMS keys rotated during the maintenance window? rewrap could have failed.
luis_ops: I ran the maintenance, we rotated staging variant of infer-wrap (v6). We expected automatic rewrap but saw errors on a subset.
sec-bot: action created INC-2026-0610 severity: medium owner: luis_ops. audit logs export: bq://projects/redwood-prod/datasets/vault_audit.vault.
ben: query I ran to find top principals: `SELECT auth.identity, COUNT(*) FROM ... WHERE path LIKE '%secret/data/%' AND timestamp BETWEEN TIMESTAMP_SECONDS(1778880000) AND TIMESTAMP_SECONDS(1778883600) GROUP BY auth.identity ORDER BY COUNT DESC;` results: svc-infer-worker (420), svc-cache (90), svc-partner-sync (60).
dalia: check renew events with large TTLs: `SELECT lease_id, path, auth.identity, ttl FROM ... WHERE request_type='renew' AND ttl>43200` — shows many leases with ttl=86400.
mira: hypothesis: autoscaler scaled down workers but they died without revoking leases, and rewrap failures prevented renew->revoke lifecycle.
luis_ops: containment plan: 1) snapshot leases to GCS, 2) set affected mounts to read-only, 3) revoke leases in staged batches (<=50), 4) rewrap ciphertexts that failed, 5) issue temporary fallback creds for impacted services.
ben: safety: do dry-run revokes first and validate decrypt errors metric. create an alert for decrypt-errors > 3 in 5m.
sre-oncall: alert AP-177888 set. will monitor decrypt-error and 5xx from cache-service.
dalia: for KMS rewrap: use Cloud KMS rewrap API rather than disabling versions. rewrap job should attempt to re-encrypt ciphertexts to key v6. I'll prepare a job with exponential backoff and idempotency.
mira: snapshot command I used: `vault list -format=json sys/leases/lookup | jq . > /tmp/leases-177888.json && gsutil cp /tmp/leases-177888.json gs://infra-dumps/inc-177888/`.
luis_ops: assigning: ben -> run batch revokes (dry-run then live), dalia -> rewrap job and integrity checks, mira -> partner/engineer notifications + mount read-only, luis_ops -> coordinate and create rollback playbook. ETA 20m for first batch.
ben: starting dry-run revoke for lease prefix lease-9f4b (echo only). no errors. proceeding with live small batch of 25.
ben: live batch-1 revoke completed. Observed 3 failures hitting svc-cache causing transient 5xx. Rolling back next batch.
mira: pinging @partners-infra: "Heads-up: we will perform staggered lease revocations in staging following KMS maintenance. If you see auth failures, tag this thread. First batch complete. ETA next batch 30m."
dalia: starting rewrap for ciphertexts referencing key infer-wrap v6. current progress: 60/240 rewraps done. no KMS API failures so far.
ben: troubleshooting svc-cache errors: they were relying on long-lived lease tokens. created temporary fallback token with reduced privilege and 2h TTL, pushed to secret path secret/fallback/cache-svc.
sre-oncall: decrypt-error alert fired twice during batch-1 but returned to baseline after fallback. monitoring continues.
luis_ops: rewrap job note: some ciphertexts were already encrypted with v5 and rewrap succeeded; a small subset (encrypted with v3) required intermediate rewrap to v5 then v6. dalia is handling multi-step rewraps.
dalia: rewrap completed 240/240. running integrity check: attempt decrypt and compare HMACs for a sample set. all good so far.
ben: prepared final revoke batches. will do 50 leases at a time, watch for errors, pause on any service-impact.
mira: discovered ~12 partner-run jobs that had cron locks referencing old leases. notif sent to partner owners to update teardown hooks.
sec-bot: post-incident recommendation: enforce max renew TTL 12h for default service roles; require explicit revoke in shutdown hooks for workers.
luis_ops: agreed. I'll open RFC/RBAC ticket and add CI tests for lease revocation on pod termination.
ben: final revoke sequence complete. remaining leases cleaned up. No further decrypt-errors after fallback tokens expired.
mira: closing notes will be attached to INC-2026-0610 and paste lease snapshot + revoke logs.
sec-bot: INC-2026-0610 status -> resolved by luis_ops at 1778882580
